title: Carrier mismatch and debugging

visualBrief.description: Compare gain-corrected message-band outputs for relative phase errors 0, 60 and 90 degrees; label ideal predictions and finite-filter residual separately.
visualBrief.alt: Carrier mismatch and debugging; Relative phase matters. Frequency mismatch can create beating. Diagnose one parameter at a time.

from.label: MathWorks: analog passband modulation; reference for the modulation families

walkthrough.say: With frequency matched and unit carrier amplitudes, ideal gain-corrected recovery is m(t)*cos(phi), where phi is relative phase error.
Change only the receiver phase by 90 degrees, inspect recovery, then restore the baseline and rerun.
Relative phase matters. Frequency mismatch can create beating. Diagnose one parameter at a time.

sourceInteractive.prompt: Change relative phase error; this is an ideal message-band prediction, not a simulator result.
